training.device: cuda required for actual training; CUDA unavailable is an error, no silent CPU fallback
training.loss: time-domain normalized MSE, identity multiplier 5.0, plus 0.5 binary cross entropy artifact logit; artifact label is 1 for contaminated paired window and 0 for pure identity
training.selection: minimum validation combined loss, first epoch on exact tie; test groups never read for selection
training.normalization: per-window, per-channel noisy mean and AC RMS; model input normalized float32; inference restores float64 and preserves original noisy DC

predeclared_acceptance.clean_normalized_rmse_definition: sqrt(mean_over_all_clean_samples((output-true_clean)/per_window_noisy_AC_RMS)**2)); includes unchanged and rejected clean windows; report accepted-only separately if desired
predeclared_acceptance.snr_gain_definition: 20*log10(overall_raw_corrupted_RMSE / overall_output_corrupted_RMSE); use actual pure reference including original DC, finite failclosed when zero reference-error denominator
predeclared_acceptance.spectral_definition: per500window l2 FFT(output-raw)[8..40] divided by max(l2 FFT(rawAC)[8..40], sqrt(500)*raw_AC_RMS*1e-12); all windows/channels; unchanged raw gives exactly0
